summary: add() subtracts instead of adding: calc.py line 4 returns a - b.

findings.title: add returns a - b
findings.detail: The planted bug: add(2,3) returns -1. mul() compounds it but its tests pass anyway by luck of the implementation.

suggested_fix: Change `return a - b` to `return a + b` in calc.py.

tests.name: test_add
tests.should_fail_because: add returns a - b, so it gives -1
